name_reason: Follows convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=dialog, descriptor encodes shop/sell-for/text-id and the 'table' data-type kind. Trailing 'for' is a real word (the 'sell for whom/<price>?' prompt), not Ghidra address residue. No hex address suffix. Consistent with sibling tables in dlgtab.c (buy_for/no_money/no_equip/auto_equip/inventory_full).
purpose: Per-shop-tier FDTXT dialog page text-id for the 'sell this for <price>?' yes/no confirmation prompt in the chapter-intro shop SELL flow.
logic_summary: 6-element int16 const table indexed by the shop-tier radio state data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state (0..5). Sole reader fd2_run_sell_item_menu @ 0x2F654 block-copies the 12 bytes into a stack buffer (3x MOVSD from 0x5272A); on the sale-confirm branch it reads back MOVSX word ptr [ESP + cursor_state*2 + 0x1c] @ 0x2F80C and passes the value as the FDTXT page id to fd2_display_dialog_scene, then runs fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop for the Yes/No reply. The *2 stride + MOVSX word confirms int16 (signed) elements; index range 0..5 gives the 6-element dimension. Values: 0x01FC,0x01FC,0x01FC,0x0293,0x01FC,0x01FC (tier 3 uses a distinct page id).
element_semantics: FDTXT dialog page id (signed 16-bit) for the sell-confirm prompt, one entry per shop tier (cursor_state 0..5).
notes: Verified via disassembly of fd2_run_sell_item_menu: MOV ESI,0x5272a + 3x MOVSD at 0x2F654-0x2F65b (block copy), MOVSX EAX, word ptr [ESP+EAX*2+0x1c] at 0x2F80C with EAX=data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state (loaded from 0x5412b at 0x2F807). Memory bytes fc01 fc01 fc01 9302 fc01 fc01 match src initializer exactly. Ghidra datatype=short[6], len=12. Only READ/DATA xrefs (no writers) -> const. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT was blank; created a concise plate consistent with the src conclusion. src comment in dlgtab.c was already accurate and precise -> left unchanged (comment_verdict=keep, no Edit).
